about: The versicle and response form the final verse of Psalm 123 in the Vulgate numbering (Psalm 124:8 in Hebrew). The first part has an understood copula, while the second has its own verb, fecit.

seg.nr: The priest makes the sign of the cross.

seg.tr: Our help is in the name of the Lord.

ex.w001: Latin leaves “est” unspoken: “Adiutórium nostrum [est] in nómine Dómini” — “our help [is] in the name of the Lord”.
